findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Data/ZMod/Basic.lean:794`: `def unitOfCoprime (x : ℕ) (h : ...) : (ZMod n)ˣ := ⟨x, x⁻¹, ...⟩`, with `@[simp] theorem coe_unitOfCoprime` at line 798; the new proofs never invoke it.
findings.fix: Rewrite with `ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime` (as `ArithmeticFrobenius.lean:55` already does) before deciding, e.g. `simp [ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]` or `rw [ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]; decide`, leaving `decide` only on numeral goals like `(19 : ZMod 5) = -1`.
findings.issue: Each example closes with `by decide` on a goal containing `↑(ZMod.unitOfCoprime p _)`, so the kernel must unfold the `unitOfCoprime` structure literal rather than using the `@[simp]` lemma `ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime`. Same pattern at lines 51, 60, 68 and 77.

findings.evidence: Lines 41-43, 49-51, 58-60, 66-68, 75-77 are identical up to the prime; the sibling `Cyclotomic/FiveSplitting.lean:36` factors exactly this repetition into the private helper `ncard_primesOver_eq_of_orderOf`.
findings.fix: Add the corollary `((Rat.galEquivZMod n K σ : (ZMod n)ˣ) : ZMod n) = p` next to `galEquivZMod_eq_unitOfCoprime_of_isArithFrobAt` in `Cyclotomic/ArithmeticFrobenius.lean` (proved by `rw [galEquivZMod_eq_unitOfCoprime_of_isArithFrobAt Q hp hσ, ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]`), then each example is `rw [corollary ...]; decide`.
findings.issue: The same three-line glue (`galEquivZMod_eq_unitOfCoprime_of_isArithFrobAt` + `congrArg Units.val` + `by decide`) is repeated in all five theorems; the reusable `val`-level form of the general equation is never stated.

findings.evidence: `hnorm : absNorm (Q.under (𝓞 ℚ)) = p` has no syntactic occurrence of `v.asIdeal`; the required instance comes from `Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Over.lean:127` `instance over_under : P.LiesOver (P.under A)`, which only unifies after `v` is unfolded.
findings.fix: Make the equality explicit: `have hv : v.asIdeal = Q.under (𝓞 ℚ) := rfl`, use `rw [hv]` in `hn`, and supply `haveI : Q.LiesOver v.asIdeal := hv ▸ inferInstance` — or document why the unfolding is relied on.
findings.issue: `v` is `let`-bound to a `HeightOneSpectrum` literal, and the proof then relies, without comment, on zeta-delta unfolding of that local definition twice: `rw [..., hnorm]` (line 52) must see `absNorm v.asIdeal` as `absNorm (Q.under (𝓞 ℚ))`, and the application at line 57 needs the instance `Q.LiesOver v.asIdeal` to be found through the same unfolding.

summary: The general lemma is short and mostly idiomatic, but the five worked-example proofs repeat the same unit-coercion glue and close their goals with `decide` evaluating through `ZMod.unitOfCoprime`'s definition instead of the existing simp lemma; the general proof also leans on undocumented zeta-unfolding of a `let`-bound `HeightOneSpectrum`.
